title: Code for: Machine learning prediction of biogas production from multi-feedstock anaerobic digestion based on LightGBM and SHAP interaction analysis
description: Python scripts that reproduce all tables and figures of the manuscript: data audit of the public Indian Biogas Production dataset (Kaggle), date-based chronological split, Optuna tuning of linear regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, CatBoost and LightGBM with expanding-window time-series cross-validation, SHAP main-effect and interaction analysis with an additive-model null distribution and Benjamini-Hochberg correction, grouped permutation and drop-group analyses, and Kruskal-Wallis/Dunn seasonal tests. The dataset itself is not redistributed.
